Worth the meal
Jun 2023 • Family
In the morning, Pho restaurant has a lot of customers, sometimes you have to wait for the table to eat. The restaurant has a security guard for the car. The most famous of the restaurant is Pho beef, this is a typical dish of Vietnamese people. Noodles are cooked with broth, topping with rare beef or cooked beef. All are shared with vegetables. Southern style restaurant's noodle cooking method. Perfect food. Many service staff, most of them young. The restaurant has a street style, the space inside the restaurant is cramped, so customers often choose to sit outside. Food prices are higher than other restaurants.

Beef Pho!
Dec 2019 • Family
Perhaps a good way to have your first taste of pho in Vietnam is through a hawker-style resto. I think this method is better than from the fancy places because it reduces the commercial aspect of the cuisine. Just plain pho.

At Pho Phuong, menu is straightforward. Just choose whatever beef parts you want included in your beef noodle soup - brisket, flank, meatball, tendon, cartilage, etc. Or everything in it; this one is served at large serving size. 

Food tasted awesome and service was quick. In less than 2 minutes, food was served to our table. It was accompanied by a basket of assorted leaves (parsley, mint, etc) and beansprouts. Plus slices of lime to add zing to the soup. 

I recommend the beef brisket and flank. Consistency of the meat is perfect for the soft noodles that come with the pho. Though I ordered the “complete” kind with many different beef parts, I couldn’t eat some of them due to large fatty content. Taste though is not any less than the other types. It was delicious. 

Best to be paired with cold tea and cold milk coffee. This place is worth a return.

Pho at it's best!
Sep 2019 • Family
If your searching a place where you can be seated on the perfect spot and to comfortable to suite your taste, well this is not the place. But if your searching for one of the best beef rice noodle soup in town, this is the place for you! We ordered different kinds of combination of beef. 

✔️Beef Noodles = The beef is tender (for all types of beef) and love the texture of rice noodles. The broth itself is excellent, with the right mix of various fresh herbs and spices. You'll get to taste a good beef noodle soup.
✔️Coffee w/ Milk = One word "Yummy". The coffee is great for the price.
